newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utils Comanche nuke boosting power.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utils Comanche nuke boosting power.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co's 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 2 was operating at about 20 percent of capacity as of early Thursday and was boosting power, a company spokesman said.
"It will be going through a power increase all through the day," spokesman Eric Schmitt said Thursday, adding "it will take about 12 to 18 hours to reach 100 percent power."
The unit, located in Glen Rose, Texas, went into restart mode Wednesday after being shut Saturday for the repair of a main feedwater valve.
The adjacent 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 1 continued to operate normally at 100 percent of capacity.
The Comanche Peak units produce aobut 18 percent of Texas Utilities' power deliveries.
